scripts.build:uz: LANDING_FIXTURES=seo-fixtures PUBLIC_SITE_ID=uz astro build --force && rm -rf dist-uz && mv dist dist-uz
scripts.build:global: LANDING_FIXTURES=seo-fixtures PUBLIC_SITE_ID=global astro build --force && rm -rf dist-global && mv dist dist-global
scripts.seo:snapshot: node scripts/seo/snapshot.mjs dist-uz seo-next/uz.json && node scripts/seo/snapshot.mjs dist-global seo-next/global.json
scripts.seo:check: npm run build:uz && npm run build:global && npm run seo:snapshot && node scripts/seo/compare.mjs seo-baseline/uz.json seo-next/uz.json scripts/seo/allow.json && node scripts/seo/compare.mjs seo-baseline/global.json seo-next/global.json scripts/seo/allow.json
